name: Vital Spark · Death ×2 · Cold
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 7.5 s
• Life drain: 2.25 ❤ damage, you heal 1.17 ❤
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
